name: @lynia/parity
description: Pixel-parity screenshot lane — renders design mocks and app screens side-by-side so every alignment claim becomes an image (CLAUDE.md → 'Pixel parity'). Not a workspace package (repo globs are apps/* and packages/*), so it never enters turbo build/typecheck/test gates; it is a Claude-run tool.
//deps: playwright-core + esbuild are OPTIONAL here: the loaders in lib/ first try the container's global install (this is a Claude-run lane), then a local one. Run `npm i` in this dir only if you are on a machine without the global toolchain.
